title: Domain I: Regulatory & Compliance - CPPB Domain I: Regulatory & Compliance - UCC: Rejection of Goods
subject: CPPB Domain I: Regulatory & Compliance

questions.q: Under the UCC, if a buyer wishes to reject a shipment of nonconforming goods, the buyer must:
options: Pay for the goods first, then request a refund.
Reject the goods within a reasonable time and notify the seller.
Wait for the seller's contract term to expire entirely before speaking up.
Accept the goods and file a lawsuit for punitive damages.
questions.explain: Under the UCC, rejection of goods must be made within a reasonable time after delivery or tender, and it is ineffective unless the buyer reasonably notifies the seller.
